items.text: How do I check the status of my transfer?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
To check your transfer's status, log into your Wise account, go to Home to see your activity list, and click on the transfer you want to track. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: When will my money arrive?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
We give you an estimated delivery time when you set up your transfer. The easiest way to check the status is by logging into your Wise account and clicking on the transfer you want to track. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: Why does it say my transfer is complete when the money hasn't arrived?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
We mark your transfer as complete once we've sent the money to the recipient's bank. The remaining time allows their bank to process and release it. If you still haven't received it, ask them to check if their bank is processing the payment or if the currency and amount look different than expected. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: Why is my transfer taking longer than the estimate?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
Delays can happen if your bank takes time to send money, security checks are needed, weekends or holidays apply, or there's a mistake in recipient details. Your recipient can ask their bank to speed things up using a transfer receipt. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: What is a proof of payment?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
A proof of payment is a document showing you've sent money from your bank account, like a PDF of your bank statement or screenshot. We might ask for it if your money hasn't reached us in time or to verify the source. It must show your details, your bank's name, our details, the date, amount, currency, and reference number. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: What's a banking partner reference number?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
For every transfer you send with Wise, we give you a transfer number. For some transfers, we also provide a banking partner reference number because we use local partners to deliver your money. You should give this number to your recipient so they can track the transfer once it shows as complete on your account. They may need to share it with their bank if there are issues. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: The app says due today but my sister hasn't got anything yet.

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
If the app says your money is due today, it should have arrived already because some banks need hours to process transfers from us. Your sister can check her bank statement for a transaction from Wise or look for a reference number instead of your name. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: It's been stuck on 'your money's being processed' for three days.

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
If your transfer has been on Your money's being processed for more than two working days, you should check with your bank to make sure they've sent the money to us. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: My landlord says he can't see the payment but Wise shows it as done.

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
Wise marks your transfer complete once we've sent the money to your recipient's bank, but their bank may still be processing it. Your landlord should check their bank statement for a transaction from Wise or our banking partners using the reference number on your receipt. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: How long does a Swift transfer take to get to you?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
Swift transfers usually take one to six working days to reach us.
Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: You emailed asking me for proof I sent the money. What do I need to send?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
To upload your proof of payment, you need a document showing your name, account number, bank details, and the amount sent to us. It must be a high-quality screenshot or PDF of your bank statement, not a photo or copied text. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: What's a UTR number?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
A UTR number is the Unique Transaction Reference number used by some banks, particularly in India, to track your transfer. It is the same as the banking partner reference number Wise provides for every transfer you send. You can give this number to your recipient so they can check the status of the payment with their bank. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: I sent it on Friday afternoon and it still hasn't landed.

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
If your transfer was due today but you sent it on a Friday, the money might not show until the next working day because banks don't process transfers on weekends. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: I spelled the recipient's name slightly wrong, will the money still get there?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
Small typos like spelling John as Jon usually don't cause problems, but for some currencies it could be an issue. If your money gets returned to us, we'll let you know straight away. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: Can a screenshot from my banking app count as proof?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
Yes, a high-quality screenshot from your online banking can count as proof of payment. It must clearly show your name, account number, the bank's details, and the date and amount of the transfer. Anything copied into an email or a photo of your screen won't work. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: My recipient got less money than I sent, why?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
Your recipient's bank may have converted the money to their account currency, which could change the amount they receive. They can check their bank statement for the sender name and reference number to identify the transfer. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: Is there anything I can do to make it arrive faster?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
If your transfer is stuck waiting for your bank, check with them directly. If it's already sent to us but delayed, ask your recipient for a transfer receipt to give their bank. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: Why are you doing a security check on my transfer?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
We run extra checks to keep your money safe as part of our standard procedure for regulated financial institutions. If we need more information from you, like ID or proof of where the money came from, we'll send you an email explaining what we need. Anything else about your transfer?
